label: Every actual root has every pure perfection, from no unexplained absence and esse givers
description: Fix an actual root r at w and a pure k. By excluded middle r has k or lacks it. If r lacks k, no unexplained absence at actual roots says no admissible profile contains r's determinations and k. The root's profile is admissible and k occurs in some admissible profile, so the formal-limitation L bridge makes r's esse limited. The existing rootUnlimited (#1914) derives from the limited-esse giver premise that the actual root r is not limited, because a limited actual concretum has a distinct actual concrete ground. So r has k. This is the E and L composition of the 2026-11-24 note with the limited-esse giver. The main theorem uses no axioms. The Comparator companion esseControls (three Mathlib axioms) evaluates the giver premise and the formal-limitation L bridge over the admissible families of structuralControls: the L bridge holds with nothing limited for the open family, so the standing-rival row (only no unexplained absence fails) carries over; it fails with nothing limited for the joint-conflict family and the finite-mode profile; and at a limited source with no causal edge the L bridge holds while the giver premise fails.
